name: GL Transitions (1 of 2)
author: gl-transitions contributors (converted for Kinoklip)
description: The MIT-licensed transitions of gl-transitions (gl-transitions.com) as Kinoklip transition plugins, with their uniforms as parameters (Accordion to Marbling Dissolve).

transitions.name: Accordion
transitions.description: The outgoing image folds up like a pleated paper toward one side while the incoming one unfolds out of the other, both in 3D with lit and shadowed pleats

params.label: Pleats
params.description: Number of pleats in each image (a pleat is a pair of panels, one lit and one in the shade)

params.label: Direction X
params.description: Direction in which the images move, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down): the outgoing image folds up toward it, the incoming one unfolds from the opposite side

params.label: Direction Y
params.description: Direction in which the images move, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down): the outgoing image folds up toward it, the incoming one unfolds from the opposite side

params.label: Shading
params.description: Contrast between the lit and the shaded panels

params.label: Perspective
params.description: Amount of perspective: the valleys between the pleats recede

params.label: Back Color
params.description: Color seen around the folded images, where the valleys recede

transitions.name: Accretion Disk
transitions.description: A black hole opens in the outgoing picture and shears it into a glowing disk of its own colors; the camera swings down to the edge of the disk, whose far side is seen bent up over the dark shadow, wi...

params.label: Tilt
params.description: How far the camera swings down towards the plane of the disk

params.label: Hole Size
params.description: Radius of the hole, in frame heights

params.label: Glow
params.description: Heat of the inner disk

params.label: Hole
params.description: Color of the hole

transitions.name: Alike
transitions.description: Neighboring areas of the outgoing image with the same color flow together into ever larger rounded shapes; one after another the areas change to the incoming image's colors, part from their old neigh...

params.label: Size
params.description: Coarseness of the areas at the middle, in frame heights

params.label: Likeness
params.description: How alike two colors must be to join

transitions.name: Aperture Wipe
transitions.description: A camera aperture opens its turning blades to reveal the incoming image

params.label: Blades
params.description: Number of blades

params.label: Rotation
params.description: How much the blades turn while opening, in degrees

params.label: Shadow
params.description: How dark the blades are shaded along their edges

transitions.name: Arrow Wipe
transitions.description: A notched arrowhead window onto the incoming image flies in from the edge behind it (or appears at the center), then swells until it fills the frame

params.label: Direction X
params.description: Direction the arrow points and flies toward

params.label: Direction Y
params.description: Direction the arrow points and flies toward

params.label: Notch
params.description: Depth of the notch at the back of the arrowhead (0 for a plain triangle)

params.label: Width
params.description: Opening angle of the arrowhead's tip, in degrees

params.label: Count
params.description: Number of nested chevrons flying in a row

params.label: Origin
params.description: Grow the arrow from the center of the frame instead of flying it in

params.label: Smoothness
params.description: Softness of the arrow's edges

transitions.name: Ascii
transitions.description: The image turns into text-mode characters, denser where it is brighter, the characters scramble into those of the incoming image, then resolve back into it

params.label: Cell Size
params.description: Height of a character, in frame heights

params.label: Colored
params.description: Color the characters with the image (otherwise, with the ink color)

params.label: Ink
params.description: Color of the characters when they are not colored with the image

params.label: Background
params.description: Color behind the characters

transitions.name: Band Wipe
transitions.description: Alternating bands wipe in from opposite sides together and interleave like fingers, while both images stay still

params.label: Bands
params.description: Number of bands

params.label: Vertical
params.description: Cut the frame into columns that wipe up and down instead of rows that wipe sideways

params.label: Smoothness
params.description: Softness of the bands' leading edges

params.label: Stagger
params.description: Delay between the first and the last band, so they cascade from the top (or the left)

params.label: Holes
params.description: Number of rows of holes across the frame

params.label: Rim
params.description: Radius of the rims and beads, in frame heights (at most a seventh of the space between holes)

params.label: Gloss
params.description: Strength of the reflections and of the magnification in the liquid

params.label: Turns
params.description: Turns made by the star

params.label: Winding

params.label: Drift

transitions.name: Block Cover
transitions.description: Blocks of a solid color pop in at random over the outgoing image until they cover the frame, then pop out in another random order to show the incoming image

params.label: Color
params.description: Color of the blocks

params.label: Pop
params.description: How much a block overshoots its cell as it pops in

params.label: Smoothness
params.description: Softness of the blocks' edges, in blocks

params.label: Grid X

params.label: Grid Y
params.description: Number of blocks (columns, rows), at most 40 along the direction

params.label: Direction X

params.description: How strongly the petals curl back as they open

transitions.name: Blueprint

params.label: Line Width
params.description: Thickness of the drawn lines

params.label: Grid
params.description: Visibility of the drafting grid

params.label: Paper
params.description: Color of the drafting paper

params.label: Ink
params.description: Color of the drawn lines

transitions.name: Bokeh Dissolve
transitions.description: The image falls out of focus like a camera lens, its highlights swelling into large bright bokeh discs, and the incoming image sharpens back out of its own bokeh

params.label: Radius

params.label: Blades
params.description: Number of aperture blades, which shape the discs into polygons (below 3: round)

params.label: Threshold
params.description: Brightness above which a pixel is a highlight that swells into a disc

params.label: Intensity
params.description: Brightness of the bokeh discs

params.label: Shading

transitions.description: The outgoing image drops out of the frame with a few bounces, revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: Bow Tie Horizontal

transitions.name: Brush Wipe
transitions.description: A few broad brush strokes sweep across the frame in turn, back and forth, painting in the incoming image with streaky bristle edges and dry, ragged ends

params.label: Roughness
params.description: How rough the bristles make the edges and ends of the strokes

params.label: Waviness
params.description: How much the strokes wave along their way

transitions.name: Butterfly Wave Scrawler
transitions.description: Wavy, color-separated ripples scramble the outgoing image into the incoming one

params.label: Strength
params.description: How far the camera jolts (and rolls) at the peak of the shake

params.label: Jolts
params.description: Number of jolts over the transition

params.label: Blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur along each jolt

params.label: Split
params.description: How far the color channels split apart along each jolt

params.label: Grid X

params.label: Grid Y
params.description: Number of cards (columns, rows), at most 6 by 6

params.label: Deck X
params.description: Point the cards are dealt from, can be outside the frame

params.label: Deck Y
params.description: Point the cards are dealt from, can be outside the frame

transitions.name: Card Swipe
transitions.description: The outgoing image is flicked off like the top card of a stack, swinging around a point below it as it flies out, while the incoming card behind it grows to fill the frame

params.description: Direction in which the outgoing card is flicked

transitions.description: Irregular cells, like cracked mud or soap foam, switch to the incoming image one by one, with an optional bright border glowing along the cracks between them

params.label: Cells

params.label: Smoothness
params.description: Duration of each cell's switch, as a fraction of the transition (0: each cell switches at once)

params.label: Border Color

transitions.name: Chessboard
transitions.description: A chessboard pattern of squares reveals the incoming image

params.label: Color3

params.description: Softness of the circle's edge

params.description: Number of teeth of the rake dragged up and down, along the longer side of the frame

params.label: Pull
params.description: How far the teeth of the rake drag the picture, in frame heights (the fine comb drags it 0.6 times as far)

params.label: Bands
params.description: Number of bands of ink across the frame

params.label: Veins
params.description: How dark the thin lines of ink between the two images are
